name: poketokenbar
description: AI coding tool usage in your status bar

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The usage helper process is started only in trusted workspaces, since an untrusted folder can contribute configuration.

poketokenbar.refreshIntervalSeconds.markdownDescription: How often to refresh usage. There is deliberately **no setting for the helper executable path**: a folder you open can contribute configuration, so such a setting would let a repository choose what this extension runs.

scripts.dev: npm run copy-sidecar && npm run compile
